nom: BYOMA Hydrating Serum with Tri-Ceramide Complex

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including a postpartum reviewer and one with sensitive/dry skin, generally report noticeable hydration and softer skin, though several with very dry skin say it isn't enough on its own and needs a richer moisturizer layered on top.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with redness-prone or reactive skin, consistently report no irritation and often note it calms redness and helps a stressed skin barrier.
segments.oily: The few reviewers with oily skin report it helps control oil and gives a glow without feeling heavy, though one reviewer with textured oily skin noticed no real difference after a couple of weeks.
segments.normal: Reviewers who describe their skin as normal report it works well as a light hydration boost that layers easily with other products.
segments.mature: One reviewer with older, aging, dry skin found it did not noticeably help her skin, suggesting lighter serums may suit mature skin better than this one did for her.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports a reduction in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, but another with mature, aging skin did not notice this serum helping her fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report visible hydration and softer, plumper skin after use, but several others, including some with very dry or sensitive skin, found it only mildly hydrating and not sufficient on its own, especially in colder weather.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness, including one whose skin was reactive and irritated from other products, report this serum calmed their skin and reduced redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the tri-ceramide formula with helping repair or support their skin barrier, describing calmer, less reactive skin after use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some note fewer blemishes or clearer skin, though one reviewer had some breakouts during the test period and was unsure if the product was the cause.
concerns.oiliness: The small number of reviewers with oily skin say it helped calm excess oil without feeling heavy.

aspects.libelle: Pump can be stiff or prone to clogging
Feels slightly tacky just after application
Good value, a little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Not as hydrating as I hoped
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to like this serum but I just didn't find it very hydrating. I wouldn't have knocked off stars but since the product is marketed as a hydration serum and it just didn't work for me. The ingredients are better for barrier repair, so if your moisture barrier is compromised this would work great! For general maintenance of your barrier I wouldn't recommend it. The product applied just fine and worked under makeup.

extraits.titre: Not as great for mature dry skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had a lot of high hopes for this Byoma Hydrating serum. It is super lightweight in my opinion, however it doesn't really help my older aging dry skin. I was hoping it would as the lighter serums definitely feel better for mature skin. It's very good for sensitive skin though, and caused no irritations. It's easy to pump out an amount you want to use easily. It's a great looking container that catches your eye when walking through the store. The brand is also really good. But for me, this didn't work the way I had hoped it would.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] OMGGG! This serum helped my skin barrier so much, I had a super red and sensitive skin around my lips and chin from using rejuvenating products so anything I used will be so painful but when I used this one, I was surprised by how gentle and hydrating it is. My skin is back to normal, it is super lightweight and I noticed it makes my skin super soft after applying. I also love how light scented it is. I 100% recommend this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have oily skin and I noticed it's always oily so for me the Byoma hydrating serum helps not only make my face soft feeling with a glow but I noticed it's helping calm down so much oil on my face. I like that it's very light and goes on so smoothly. It has a light pretty scent and the right amount comes out when I dispenses it.

extraits.titre: Best for normal to oily skin
extraits.texte: Not really scented at all, I used it after my byoma hydrating milky toner, and after the ordinary toner, and it layered with my other products really well. I think on a scale of 1-5 on hydrating, this one is about a 2.5. The squalane and glycerin make it to where your skin is softer afterwards, and the glycerin does hydrate your skin. Theres no vitamin B5 or niacinamide which would give more hydration throughout the day but this is a nice formula that is light weight and pairs well with other things. I wouldn't personally reach for it often because I have very dry/sensitive skin, but if you have a normal face type and are looking for a little boost to your skin, it's a great option. The actual formula is white, comes out thinner, spreads well and gives a fresh sensation being put on, dries fairly quickly.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is super hydrating! I've been using it right before my moisturizer at night and it's been really helping my dry skin! I'm post partum and have been really struggling with dry skin. The application is really easy to use but the top did break on mine, but I'm able to pop it right back in.
